description: This source file implements the 'rebase_path' function for GN build scripts, providing path rebasing utilities including handling of directories and files, with detailed documentation and path conversion logic.

methods.name: MakeSlashEndingMatchInput
methods.description: Adjusts the slash ending of the output string to match the input string's slash ending.

methods.name: ValueLooksLikeDir
methods.description: Determines if a string value appears to be a directory based on trailing dots or slashes.

methods.name: AddCallLocationToError
methods.description: Attaches call location information to an error object for better debugging.

methods.name: ConvertOnePath
methods.description: Converts a single path value to a different base, handling directory and file paths, and system absolute paths.

methods.name: RunRebasePath
methods.description: Main function that processes arguments to rebase paths, supporting both string and list inputs, with path resolution and error handling.
